description: GRANT and REVOKE of ROLES and of PRIVILEGES, read back through SHOW GRANTS. A role granted to another role appears as a USAGE grant on the ROLE domain; revoking removes it; a multi-level hierarchy chains. Privileges grant singly and in lists, on tables, views, schemas and databases, and REVOKE takes a list too, leaving the untouched ones behind. GRANT OWNERSHIP records an OWNERSHIP row. GRANT ALL stores the EXPANSION and never an ALL row - live-verified, the individual DML privileges appear and no row is named ALL - so one expanded privilege can be revoked on its own while the rest remain, and REVOKE ALL then clears everything but OWNERSHIP. A qualified object name and the schema-context short name reach the same object. Converted from security/GrantRevokeTest, which is KEPT (trimmed) for the six user-grant tests that read the catalog directly - SHOW GRANTS TO USER reports only role grants, so a privilege granted to a USER has no SQL read-back; see the task note. The Java scanned SHOW GRANTS rows POSITIONALLY (column 1 the privilege, 2 the granted_on, 3 the name); these steps read the same rows BY NAME through RESULT_SCAN.

steps.sql: CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS parent_role
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS child_role
GRANT ROLE child_role TO ROLE parent_role
SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE parent_role
SELECT "privilege", "granted_on", "name" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'CHILD_ROLE'
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS parent_role
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS child_role
GRANT ROLE child_role TO ROLE parent_role
REVOKE ROLE child_role FROM ROLE parent_role
SHOW GRANTS TO ROLE parent_role
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'CHILD_ROLE'

SELECT "name" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "granted_on" = 'ROLE'

SELECT "name" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "granted_on" = 'ROLE'

GRANT SELECT ON TABLE grant_test_table TO ROLE admin_role
GRANT SELECT ON VIEW grant_test_view TO ROLE admin_role
SHOW GRANTS ON DATABASE grant_test_db
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "privilege" = 'USAGE'
SHOW GRANTS ON TABLE grant_test_table
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "privilege" = 'SELECT'
